met_analysis:
The Depression over south Chhattisgarh and adjoining south interior Odisha moved north-northwestwards with a speed of 13 kmph during past 06 hours and lies centered at 1730 hrs IST of today, the 25th September 2026 over north Chhattisgarh, near latitude 22.0°N and longitude 82.2°E, close to south-southeast of Bilaspur (Chhattisgarh), about 50 km west of Champa (Chhattisgarh), 90 km south-southeast of Pendra Road (Chhattisgarh) and 270 km south of Sidhi (Madhya Pradesh). It is very likely to move north-northwestwards towards southeast Uttar Pradesh across north Chhattisgarh & northeast Madhya Pradesh as a depression till evening of 26th September. Continuing to move further north-northwestwards, it is very likely to weaken gradually into a well-marked low pressure area during subsequent 12 hours.
The Western Disturbance as a trough in middle tropospheric westerlies with its axis at 7.6 km above mean sea level roughly along Long. 72°E to the north of Lat. 26°N persists.
